out_of_schema_notes: Transfer plan spans the whole process train; entities are the sites, the Step 3-10 process steps and the CQAs preserved across the transfer.
The distinctive objects are the TransferGap entries (transfer_has_gap assertions).
CPP/WC-CPP counts and the commercial-scale capability are reported as report_sections statements (no dedicated field).

inventory.rationale: Title block declares document class 'Process Transfer Plan'.

process_steps.description: Forms the glycan, charge-variant and aggregate CQAs (design-space step)
Primary recovery and clarification; forms no product-quality CQA
Capture; sets leached Protein A; principal HCP and DNA clearance
Low-pH hold; sets the cumulative XMuLV (enveloped) clearance
Polish; principal aggregate reduction; major HCP/DNA/leached-PA clearance
Flow-through polish; sets the cumulative MVM clearance; clears XMuLV/HCP/DNA
Dedicated small-virus removal; principal MVM clearance
Formulation / mass balance; delivers drug substance at target concentration

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 defines the strategy and scope for transferring the A-Mab drug-substance process from the sending site to the receiving site.

source_references.quote: strategy and scope for transferring the A-Mab drug-substance

statements.statement_text: The transfer is a knowledge transfer of the characterized process understanding, confirmed by site-equivalency analysis, engineering runs and a commercial-scale PPQ campaign.
The commercial process operates at 15,000 L and delivers approximately 54.6 kg of drug substance.
Of the 37 process parameters, 21 are critical and their commercial-scale control must be confirmed.
The gap analysis identifies the differences that must be resolved before or during the transfer.
Commercial-scale confirmation is provided by a Stage-2 PPQ campaign and reported in PCMR-001.

transfer_gaps.description: The commercial-scale chromatography skids and production bioreactor at the receiving site differ in make and control system from the development equipment.
transfer_gaps.impact: Operating ranges and control response may differ at commercial scale.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Engineering runs and equipment qualification confirm that the CPP and WC-CPP ranges transfer.

source_references.quote: commercial-scale chromatography skids and production bioreactor

transfer_gaps.description: The validated release and characterization methods must be transferred and co-validated at the receiving-site QC laboratory.
transfer_gaps.impact: Method bias between sites could confound the comparability assessment.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Method-transfer protocols with cross-site precision and accuracy acceptance criteria are executed before PPQ.

source_references.quote: transferred and co-validated at the receiving-site QC laboratory

transfer_gaps.description: The Grafton commercial drug-substance facility and its utilities require qualification for A-Mab manufacture.
transfer_gaps.impact: Facility fit, segregation and environmental controls must be demonstrated for the process.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Facility, utility and equipment qualification is completed before the engineering and PPQ batches.

source_references.quote: facility and its utilities require qualification for A-Mab manufacture

transfer_gaps.description: The resin, virus-retentive membrane, depth-filter media and cell-culture media/feed lots at commercial scale differ from the development lots.
transfer_gaps.impact: Raw-material and consumable lot-to-lot variability could affect clearance, yield or product quality.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Raw-material and consumable lot bridging with incoming specifications and resin/membrane life-cycle control is applied.

transfer_gaps.description: The characterized CPPs, WC-CPPs and the multivariate design spaces must be confirmed at commercial scale.
transfer_gaps.impact: Scale effects on the design space and on the cumulative viral clearance must be verified.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: The Stage-2 PPQ campaign confirms the CPP ranges, the design spaces and the cumulative viral clearance at commercial scale.

source_references.quote: must be confirmed at commercial scale

transfer_gaps.description: The per-CQA control strategy defined during characterization must be implemented in the receiving-site master batch records and in-process-control plan.
transfer_gaps.impact: Incomplete transfer of in-process controls and limits could weaken the control of a CQA.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: The control strategy is transferred by mapping every in-process control and limit into the master batch records and confirming them in PPQ.
